//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-1012
//  Prev Day + Countdown + Vol Report
//  Previous day H/L/C, Candle countdown timer, Volatility report generator
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-1012 · Prev Day + Countdown + Vol Report", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st1_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show previous day H/L/C",       group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cHi = input.color(#ffd700, "PD High",  inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cLo = input.color(#ffd700, "PD Low",   inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cCl = input.color(#ffffff, "PD Close", inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")

[st1_h, st1_l, st1_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st1_on ? st1_h : na, "PD High",  color = st1_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st1_on ? st1_l : na, "PD Low",   color = st1_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st1_on ? st1_c : na, "PD Close", color = st1_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
// (none selected)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
sd1_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show candle countdown", group = "Side · Countdown")
sd1_col = input.color(#c9a84c, "Countdown colour",      group = "Side · Countdown")
sd1_sz  = input.string("Small", "Countdown size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = "Side · Countdown")

sd1_size = sd1_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : sd1_sz == "Small" ? size.small : sd1_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : sd1_sz == "Large" ? size.large : size.huge

sd1_left = time_close - timenow
sd1_secs = math.max(0, math.floor(sd1_left / 1000))
sd1_h    = math.floor(sd1_secs / 3600)
sd1_m    = math.floor((sd1_secs % 3600) / 60)
sd1_s    = sd1_secs % 60
sd1_pad(v) =>
    v < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(v) : str.tostring(v)
sd1_txt = (sd1_h > 0 ? sd1_pad(sd1_h) + ":" : "") + sd1_pad(sd1_m) + ":" + sd1_pad(sd1_s)

var label sd1_lbl = na
if sd1_on and barstate.islast
    label.delete(sd1_lbl)
    sd1_lbl := label.new(bar_index + 2, close, sd1_txt, style = label.style_label_left, color = #00000000, textcolor = sd1_col, size = sd1_size)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds2_on  = input.bool(true, "Show volatility report", group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_len = input.int(14, "Report ATR length", minval = 1,    group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Report text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_pos = input.string("Top right", "Volatility report position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")

ds2_atr   = ta.atr(ds2_len)
ds2_atr20 = ta.sma(ds2_atr, 20)
ds2_datr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_watr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_rel   = ds2_atr20 > 0 ? 100.0 * ds2_atr / ds2_atr20 : 0.0
ds2_col   = ds2_rel > 120 ? #c9a84c : ds2_rel < 80 ? #9aa0a6 : #00abff

ds2_size = ds2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

ds2_where = ds2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds2_t = table.new(ds2_where, 2, 5, border_width = 0)
ds2_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds2_row(1, "ATR (chart)", str.tostring(ds2_atr,  format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(2, "ATR daily",   str.tostring(ds2_datr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(3, "ATR weekly",  str.tostring(ds2_watr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(4, "vs 20 avg",   str.tostring(ds2_rel, "#") + "%", ds2_col)
